topics.lesson_subject: FortiOS Carrier GTP profiles and subscriber-scoped GTP tunnel diagnostics
topics.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: GTPv0/v1/v2 profile inspection applied by firewall policy; diagnostic filter selectors narrow live tunnel list/flush by VDOM, profile, version, IMSI, MSISDN, mobile address, APN and control/user F-TEID.
topics.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: subscriber GTP-C/GTP-U traffic -> firewall policy -> GTP profile inspection; operator filter -> diagnose firewall gtp tunnel list/flush -> selected tunnel evidence or scoped cleanup.
topics.failure_class: subscriber tunnel state mismatch; incorrect assumption that a diagnostic filter is a policy; overbroad tunnel flush.
topics.evidence_pattern: policy/profile binding; tunnel list before and after filters; IMSI/MSISDN/APN/mobile address; F-TEID-C and F-TEID-U; version-specific selector acceptance.
topics.remediation_path: verify GTP feature visibility, policy/profile attachment and profile counters; apply narrow filter; clear filter state; flush only after peer/session impact is understood.
topics.question_fingerprint: distinguish control-plane F-TEID from user-plane F-TEID and diagnostic filtering from enforcement.
topics.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: mobile core split GTP-C/GTP-U lanes through FortiGate policy/profile; sidecar operator filter to tunnel table.

topics.lesson_subject: PBKDF2 administrator password migration and downgrade compatibility policy
topics.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: FortiManager stores admin passwords with randomized-salt PBKDF2; legacy SHA256 remains until a successful post-upgrade login migrates the credential; downgrade policy determines whether legacy hash is retained or deleted.
topics.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: upgrade -> dormant accounts remain SH2 -> successful login/reset -> PB2 generated -> password-policy decides legacy SHA256 retention -> downgrade either restores legacy hash or locks out admins.
topics.failure_class: mixed credential-hash population; local-admin lockout after downgrade; false confidence from upgrading without dormant-account migration.
topics.evidence_pattern: show system admin user; PB2 versus SH2 prefix; old-password field; login-lockout-upon-downgrade value; staged downgrade test.
topics.remediation_path: inventory local admins; require login or reset dormant accounts; choose downgrade policy deliberately; preserve tested recovery account and supported upgrade path.
topics.question_fingerprint: identify when migration occurs and how the downgrade flag changes the retained credential set.
topics.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: upgrade pipeline with SH2 legacy store, successful-login migration to PB2, policy branch to retained/deleted legacy hash and downgrade outcome.
topics.semantic_overlap_decision: PASS — no substantially equivalent feature/workflow fingerprint found in the strict 30-day inventory.

topics.lesson_subject: FortiSwitchOS administrator password change closes that administrator's active sessions
topics.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: FortiSwitchOS 8.0.0 automatically closes all sessions being used by the administrator whose password changes; earlier releases allowed existing sessions to continue.
topics.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: administrator changes password -> switch updates credential -> active sessions belonging to that admin are closed -> administrator reauthenticates with new password.
topics.failure_class: unexpected CLI/GUI/API session termination during credential rotation; confusion with account lockout or other administrators' sessions.
topics.evidence_pattern: two concurrent sessions under same admin; password-change event; session disconnect; successful new login with updated credential.
topics.remediation_path: schedule credential rotation; use a separate break-glass admin for observation; reconnect with new credential; verify other admin identities independently.
topics.question_fingerprint: recognize per-administrator session invalidation as a security effect of password change, not global device reboot or lockout.
topics.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: admin password-change action to credential store with fan-out termination of same-admin GUI/SSH sessions and new-auth path.
topics.semantic_overlap_decision: PASS — no substantially equivalent feature/workflow fingerprint found in the strict 30-day inventory.

topics.lesson_subject: FortiAP WTP-profile EST/SCEP automatic CA certificate enrollment and renewal
topics.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: FortiGate WTP profile enables AP-local automatic CA certificate enrollment over EST or SCEP for FortiAPs on an 802.1X WAN port; configurable key algorithm, subject/SAN, CA trust and renewal lead time.
topics.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: WTP profile -> AP connects on 802.1X WAN -> EST/SCEP enrollment request -> CA issues local AP certificate -> AP stores certificate -> auto-regeneration at configured days before expiry.
topics.failure_class: AP local certificate enrollment failure; EST TLS trust/authentication failure; confusion between AP local certificate issuance and CAPWAP DTLS trust of controller certificate.
topics.evidence_pattern: AP firmware >=7.6.4; WTP profile enrollment flags; EST/SCEP server reachability; CA request/issuance; local certificate expiry and renewal state; CAPWAP DTLS CA validation is separate.
topics.remediation_path: confirm AP firmware and 802.1X WAN placement; validate EST HTTPS CA, CA ID and HTTP credentials; verify subject/SAN and crypto algorithm; test renewal window; separately validate FortiGate controller CA chain.
topics.question_fingerprint: distinguish EST/SCEP enrollment of an AP-local certificate from validation of the FortiGate certificate during CAPWAP DTLS.
topics.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: FortiGate WTP profile controls AP -> EST/SCEP CA enrollment -> local AP certificate store and renewal timer; separate controller DTLS trust branch.

topics.lesson_subject: FortiAuthenticator RADSec server certificate trust and encrypted RADIUS accounting
topics.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: FortiAuthenticator accepts RADSec TLS clients on configurable port (default 2083), presents a dedicated RADSEC Server Certificate, validates client certificates against configured Local/Trusted CAs, then passes decrypted RADIUS authentication/accounting to the standard RADIUS daemon.
topics.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: RADSec client TLS connect -> server certificate presentation and client certificate validation -> TLS decryption -> RADIUS daemon processes Access/Accounting messages as standard UDP RADIUS -> downstream policy/accounting consumers.
topics.failure_class: TLS handshake or client-certificate trust failure; confusion between RADSEC server cert and EAP server cert; TLS transport succeeds but accounting application processing is absent.
topics.evidence_pattern: RADSEC Server Certificate; Local/Trusted CA list; port 2083 or configured service port; TLS client certificate chain; concurrent client count; RADIUS accounting records.
topics.remediation_path: install correct server certificate; trust the issuing CA for client certificates; confirm service port and client trust chain; test accounting separately from TLS handshake; remain within 500 concurrent RADSec clients.
topics.question_fingerprint: identify which side's certificate is presented and which CA set validates the RADSec client; separate TLS success from RADIUS accounting success.
topics.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: RADSec client TLS tunnel to FortiAuthenticator certificate-validation gate, then RADIUS daemon and accounting consumers.
topics.semantic_overlap_decision: PASS — no substantially equivalent feature/workflow fingerprint found in the strict 30-day inventory.

topics.lesson_subject: FortiSIEM policy-based and CSV file-based Event Tagging precedence
topics.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: Event Pipeline tagging enriches or overwrites parsed event attributes using ordered policy rules and ordered CSV files; policy-based tagging runs before file-based tagging; later matching rules/files may overwrite earlier values; each class has a separate Apply action.
topics.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: incoming parsed event -> policy tagging rules top-to-bottom/all matches -> file-based CSV tagging top-to-bottom/all matches -> final enriched event -> rules/search/reporting.
topics.failure_class: unexpected attribute overwritten by later rule/file; saved but unapplied configuration; CSV header/key mismatch; organization scope mismatch.
topics.evidence_pattern: Event Pipeline > Event Tagging; enabled rules and order; CSV header/key-value rows; separate Apply status; before/after event attributes.
topics.remediation_path: make rule order explicit; validate CSV header and key mapping; apply policy and file tagging separately; test representative events before changing production order.
topics.question_fingerprint: determine final attribute value when multiple policy and file-based matches occur.
topics.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: parsed event through policy rule chain then CSV file chain with overwrite precedence into enriched event store.

topics.lesson_subject: Dynamic SD-WAN link monitors for ADVPN shortcut tunnels
topics.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: FortiOS dynamically creates a link monitor for each ADVPN shortcut on the spoke; it sends ICMP probes to the shortcut gateway and reports link quality without counting those probes as user traffic that keeps the shortcut alive.
topics.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: spoke establishes ADVPN shortcut -> dynamic monitor appears for shortcut -> ICMP probe to gateway -> health-check reports alive/loss/latency/jitter -> SD-WAN can use measured health while user traffic remains separately accounted for tunnel idle timer.
topics.failure_class: shortcut has no health visibility; monitor mistaken for user traffic; tunnel idle timer behavior misdiagnosed; probe target unreachable despite data-plane path.
topics.evidence_pattern: diagnose sys sdwan health-check before/after shortcut; separate parent and shortcut Seq entries; packet-loss/latency/jitter; user traffic counters and shortcut idle state.
topics.remediation_path: confirm shortcut establishment and gateway reachability; inspect dynamic health-check entry; compare probe results with user traffic; do not treat monitor probes as tunnel keepalive traffic.
topics.question_fingerprint: identify the automatically created ICMP monitor and its separation from user-data traffic for shortcut lifetime.
topics.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: hub-and-spoke underlays with dynamic spoke-to-spoke shortcut plus sidecar ICMP health monitor and separate user-data/idle accounting lanes.
topics.semantic_overlap_decision: PASS — no substantially equivalent feature/workflow fingerprint found in the strict 30-day inventory.
